integrity.claim_scope: complete reduced singular locus, algebraic local determinantal model, transverse multiplicity and projective degree
integrity.computations: Symbolic Plucker-minor and Hilbert arithmetic in verify.py; no finite tests represented as global proof
integrity.external_premises: Classical Grassmannian line classification, Plucker quadrics, normal Cohen-Macaulay determinantal coordinate rings and blow-up intersection formula are used with stated hypotheses.

scientific_limitations: Only the balanced (3,6,2) truncated Grassmannian over complex numbers; no general-truncation classification.
Reduced singular locus and local models determined, not integral cohomology or full global syzygies.
Historical priority remains provisional; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Singular locus and transverse determinantal geometry of a truncated Grassmannian
